# Native select

> Native select control styled to match the Control UI control family.

This file matches the installed `native-select` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/native-select.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/native-select.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/field-knobs`: `fieldKnobs`, types `FieldKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/native-select`: `NativeSelect`, types `NativeSelectProps`

## Composition

### Native options

```tsx
<NativeSelect>
  <optgroup>
    <option />
  </optgroup>
</NativeSelect>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Label } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/label";

import { NativeSelect } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/native-select";

export function PrimitiveNativeSelectExample() {
  const [model, setModel] = useState("sonnet");

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-xs flex-col gap-2">
      <Label htmlFor="ns-model">Default model</Label>
      <NativeSelect id="ns-model" size="sm" value={model} onChange={(event) => setModel(event.target.value)}>
        <option value="sonnet">Claude Sonnet</option>
        <option value="opus">Claude Opus</option>
        <option value="haiku">Claude Haiku</option>
      </NativeSelect>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `native-select`
  - `icon`: `data-field-kind` (`native-select`)
  - `root`: `data-field-kind` (`native-select`), `data-size` (`lg` | `md` | `sm` | `xs`)
  - `wrapper`: `data-field-kind` (`native-select`)
